text:
Predicates:
Private(x) ::: x is private.
IvyLeague(x) ::: x is an Ivy League university.
ResearchUniversity(x) ::: x is a research university.
University(x) ::: x is a university.
Move(x, y) ::: x moved to y.
Year(y) ::: y is a year.
EndowmentValue(x, y) ::: x's endowment was valued at y.
OrganizedInto(x, y) ::: x is organized into y.
ConstituentCollege(x) ::: x is a constituent college.
School(x) ::: x is a school.
Premises:
Private(yaleUniversity) ∧ IvyLeague(yaleUniversity) ∧ ResearchUniversity(yaleUniversity) ::: Yale University is a private Ivy League research university.
Move(yaleUniversity, newHaven) ∧ Year(year1716) ::: Yale University moved to New Haven in 1716.
EndowmentValue(yaleUniversity, value42.3B) ::: Yale university's endowment was valued at $42.3 billion.
OrganizedInto(yaleUniversity, twentySeven) ∧ ConstituentCollege(residentialColleges) ∧ School(yaleGraduateSchoolOfArtsAndSciences) ∧ School(twelveProfessionalSchools) ::: Yale University has been organized into 27 constituent colleges and schools: the residential colleges, the Yale Graduate School of Arts and Sciences, and twelve professional schools.
Conclusion:
∃x (Private(x) ∧ IvyLeague(x) ∧ ResearchUniversity(x) ∧ Move(x, newHaven)) ::: A private Ivy League research university moved to New Haven.
